Lochia.6: Nyuma yo kubyara, lochia ni amatembabuzi yo mu gitsina ajyanye n'uburyo karemano inda ibyara yongera kumera neza. Ibara ryayo n'ingano yayo bihinduka buhoro buhoro mu minsi n'ibyumweru bikurikira.
Lochia.12: Ni ryari wakwiriye gushaka inama z'abaganga?
Lochia.15: Lochia ni amatembabuzi yo mu gitsina agaragara nyuma yo kubyara. Agizwe ahanini no gusohoka buhoro buhoro kw'amaraso, amatembabuzi, n'inyama zo mu nda ibyara igihe irimo gukira.
Lochia.16: Itandukanye n'imihango isanzwe. Iba ikiri iyo gutegerezwa mu gihe cya nyuma yo kubyara kandi muri rusange igabanuka buhoro buhoro.
Lochia.18: Lochia ntivuze ko imihango yawe yamaze kugaruka. Kugaruka kw'imihango ni ikindi kintu kiba nyuma.
Lochia.19: 2. Lochia ihinduka ite uko igihe gihita?
Lochia.20: Isura yayo ikunze guhinduka mu byumweru bike bya mbere. Ibara rigenda ryoroha buhoro buhoro kandi ingano ikunze kugabanuka.
Lochia.22: Ibyiciro bishobora gutandukana hagati y'umuntu n'undi
Lochia.25: Amatembabuzi akunze kuba atukura kandi ashobora kuba menshi mu ntangiriro.
Lochia.28: Ibara rigenda ryoroha buhoro buhoro kandi rishobora kwerekeza kuri roza cyangwa ikigina.
Lochia.31: Amatembabuzi akunze koroha, akaba umuhondo cyangwa umweru, mbere yo kugabanuka burundu.
Lochia.33: Uko lochia ihinduka si ko bimeze kimwe kuri bose. Impinduka zimwe zishobora kujyana mu buryo karemano no gukira nyuma yo kubyara.
Lochia.35: Ingano ishobora guhinduka mu minsi mike ya mbere hanyuma ikagabanuka buhoro buhoro.
Lochia.37: Lochia ikunze kuva ku itukura ikerekeza ku mabara yoroheje uko igihe gihita.
Lochia.39: Ishobora kumara ibyumweru byinshi, kandi uko ihinduka bitandukana hagati y'umuntu n'undi.
Lochia.40: 4. Inama zo kumererwa neza no gukurikirana
Lochia.41: Muri iki gihe, gukurikirana byoroheje bishobora kugufasha kubona uko umubiri wawe uri guhinduka utagereranya ibyo unyuramo n'iby'undi.
Lochia.43: Hitamo koga buhoro, buri gihe, utarimo ibintu bitera kurakara.
Lochia.45: Ushobora kwandika ibara, ingano, n'uko amatembabuzi ahinduka niba bigufasha gukurikirana gukira kwawe.
Lochia.47: Igihe cya nyuma yo kubyara gifata igihe. Umva umubiri wawe kandi wubahe ibyo ukeneye kugira ngo ukire.
Lochia.49: Lochia igaragara mu minsi ikurikira kubyara kandi igabanuka buhoro buhoro. Kugaruka kw'imihango, ku rundi ruhande, ni ugusubukura uruhererekane rw'imihango nyuma y'iki gihe.
Lochia.51: Amatembabuzi ajyanye no gukira kw'inda ibyara nyuma yo kubyara.
Lochia.53: Gusubukura uruhererekane rw'imihango, mu gihe gitandukana hagati y'umuntu n'undi.
Lochia.54: 6. Ni ryari wakwiriye gushaka inama z'abaganga?
Lochia.55: Niba uko bigenda bigaragara nk'ibidasanzwe kuri wowe, cyangwa niba imimerere yawe muri rusange irimo kuba mibi, ni iby'ingenzi gushaka inama z'umuganga.
Lochia.58: Umuriro cyangwa imimerere muri rusange irimo kuba mibi
Lochia.59: Amaraso ahita aba menshi cyane mu buryo butunguranye
Lochia.63: Lochia ikunze guhinduka buhoro buhoro: ishobora kuba itukura mu ntangiriro, hanyuma ikoroha mbere yo kugabanuka. Nyamara, gukira kwa buri wese kuratandukanye.
Lochia.65: Lochia ni amatembabuzi asanzwe nyuma yo kubyara.
Lochia.66: Ikunze guhindura ibara n'ingano uko ibyumweru bihita.
Lochia.67: Igihe imara n'uko ihinduka bishobora gutandukana hagati y'umuntu n'undi.
Lochia.68: Impumuro idasanzwe, umuriro, ububabare bukomeye, cyangwa amaraso menshi cyane aje gitunguranye bisaba inama z'abaganga.
Lochia.69: Ibikubiyemo by'amakuru. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama z'ubuvuzi cyangwa isuzuma. Niba ufite impungenge cyangwa ubonye ikimenyetso giteye inkeke, shaka inama z'umuganga.
Lochia.70: Gusobanukirwa lochia nyuma yo kubyara — AWA

MedicalExams.6: Ultrasound n'ibizamini by'ingenzi, ukurikije buri trimester.
MedicalExams.13: Gutwita muri rusange bikubiyemo ultrasound eshatu z'ingenzi, imwe kuri buri trimester, buri imwe ifite intego itandukanye.
MedicalExams.14: Trimester ya 1: kumenya imyaka y'inda na nuchal translucency
MedicalExams.16: Trimester ya 3: gukura n'uko umwana aryamye
MedicalExams.17: Ibizamini by'amaraso bikorwa buri gihe bigenzura ibimenyetso by'ingenzi byinshi mu gihe cyose cyo gutwita:
MedicalExams.18: Urugero rw'icyuma mu mubiri, mu gusuzuma niba hashobora kuba hari amaraso make
MedicalExams.19: Isuzuma rya diyabete yo gutwita, muri rusange hafi ya trimester ya 2
MedicalExams.20: Ubwoko bw'amaraso n'isuzuma ry'ingingo zirwanya indwara zidasanzwe
MedicalExams.21: Ibizamini bya serology (toxoplasmose, rubéole) bitewe n'uko ubwirinzi bwawe bw'umubiri bumeze
MedicalExams.22: Andika ibibazo byawe uko bije, mbere y'ukoubyibagirwa
MedicalExams.23: Jyana agatabo ko gukurikirana inda yawe kuri buri gahunda yo kubonana
MedicalExams.24: Bwira muganga ikimenyetso cyose gishya, nubwo cyaba gisa n'igito
MedicalExams.25: Umubare nyawo n'ingengabihe y'ibizamini bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'uko wivuza, urwego rw'ibyago byawe, n'imikorere y'igihugu cyawe cyangwa y'ukwita ku buzima.
MedicalExams.27: Ntuzuyaze kwandika ibibazo byawe mbere ya buri gahunda yo kubonana kugira ngo hatagira ikikurenga muri ako kanya: nta kibazo kiba gito cyane ku buryo utakibaza.

MenopauseHormones.6: Igihe menopause yegereje, imisemburo yawe ntihagarara gitunguranye: irahindagurika, ibyo bisobanura impinduka z'uruhererekane n'ibimenyetso bitandukanye bishobora kuboneka.
MenopauseHormones.9: Ni iki kiba mu gihe cya perimenopause?
MenopauseHormones.21: Imisemburo itatu y'ingenzi irahinduka muri iki gihe cyo kwimuka, buri umwe ufite uruhare rutandukanye:
MenopauseHormones.23: Igira ingaruka ku ruhererekane, uruhu, amagufwa, umutima, kandi igenga igice cy'ibitotsi n'imyumvire.
MenopauseHormones.25: Ikorwa nyuma ya ovulation, igira ingaruka iruhura kandi itegura umubiri ku gutwita gushobora kubaho.
MenopauseHormones.27: Igengwa n'ubwonko, itera intanga ngore; urugero rwayo ruhinduka uko intanga ngore zisubiza mu buryo butandukanye.
MenopauseHormones.29: Urugero rw'imisemburo ntirumanuka mu buryo bugororotse neza mu gihe cya perimenopause: rushobora guhindagurika, rukazamuka rukamanuka, mbere yo kugera ku rugero ruto nyuma ya menopause.
MenopauseHormones.30: Intanga ngore zigenda zisubiza buhoro buhoro mu buryo budahoraho ku bimenyetso by'imisemburo byoherezwa n'ubwonko. Ibi ni byo bituma uruhererekane rutaba rusanzwe kandi bisobanura impamvu ibimenyetso bishobora guhinduka kuva ku kwezi ujya ku kundi.
MenopauseHormones.32: Birashoboka rwose kugira ibimenyetso bigaragara ukwezi kumwe, hanyuma hafi nta na kimwe ukwezi gukurikira. Ibi si ibidasanzwe: bigaragaza gusa guhindagurika kw'imisemburo muri iki gihe.
MenopauseHormones.33: Impinduka muri estrogen zishobora guhuzwa n'izindi mpinduka nyinshi:
MenopauseHormones.40: Ibi bimenyetso bishobora kugira impamvu nyinshi: ntibihora bihujwe n'imisemburo, kandi ubukana bwabyo butandukana cyane hagati y'umuntu n'undi.
MenopauseHormones.41: Progesterone ikorwa gusa nyuma ya ovulation. Ariko mu gihe cya perimenopause, ovulation ubwayo irushaho kudahoraho — ibyo bigatuma ikorwa ryayo ritaba rishobora guhanurwa cyane.
MenopauseHormones.42: Uku kudahoraho gusobanura igice cy'impinduka zibonwa mu ruhererekane: uburebure bubaho butandukanye, imihango rimwe na rimwe myinshi cyangwa mike kurusha mbere.
MenopauseHormones.43: Uretse guhindagurika kw'imisemburo, hari ibindi bintu byinshi bigira uruhare: ubwiza bw'ibitotsi, urugero rw'umunaniro w'ubwenge, imibereho, n'itandukaniro ryihariye kuri buri muntu.
MenopauseHormones.44: "Buri mugore anyura muri iki gihe cyo kwimuka mu buryo bwe."
MenopauseHormones.54: Uru rutonde ni urw'amakuru gusa: si isuzuma ry'indwara. Buri muntu agira imvange itandukanye y'izi mpinduka.
MenopauseHormones.55: Ibyuya by'ijoro bishobora guca ibitotsi, bigatera umunaniro n'ingorane zo kwita ku kintu bukeye — ibi bikunze kuba muri iki gihe.
MenopauseHormones.57: Icyumba gikonje, imyenda yoroheje, na gahunda ihamye yo kuryama bishobora gufasha kugabanya uko gukanguka.
MenopauseHormones.58: Guhindagurika kw'imisemburo bishobora guhura n'impinduka mu myumvire, ariko si byo bisobanura byose: ibitotsi, umunaniro w'ubwenge, impinduka mu buzima, n'ibimenyetso by'umubiri na byo bigira uruhare.
MenopauseHormones.60: Kumva ufite amarangamutima menshi muri iki gihe ntibivuze ko hari ikitagenda neza: ni uburambe busanzwe bushobora kugira impamvu nyinshi icyarimwe.
MenopauseHormones.61: Urugero rw'imisemburo rushobora guhinduka cyane kuva ku munsi ujya ku wundi mu gihe cya perimenopause. Bityo, igipimo kimwe ntigihora gitanga ishusho yuzuye y'ibiriho.
MenopauseHormones.63: Isuzuma ry'ubuvuzi rishingira ahanini ku myaka yawe, ibimenyetso byawe, n'amateka y'uruhererekane rwawe — si umubare umwe gusa.
MenopauseHormones.64: Kwandika ibyo unyuramo ukwezi ku kwezi bigufasha kubona imiterere yawe bwite aho kwigereranya n'abandi:
MenopauseHormones.73: Gukurikirana uruhererekane rwawe muri AWA bishobora kugufasha kubona imiterere yawe bwite uko amezi ahita, nta mbaraga zirenzeho.
MenopauseHormones.74: Ibi byinshi bisaba kujya kureba muganga bisanzwe, ku muvuduko wawe:
MenopauseHormones.76: Ibimenyetso bigira ingaruka zikomeye ku buzima bwawe bwa buri munsi
MenopauseHormones.82: Impungenge zijyanye no kuma kw'igitsina cyangwa ubuzima bwawe bw'imibonano
MenopauseHormones.84: Kuva amaraso menshi cyane cyangwa adasanzwe, ku rundi ruhande, bigomba kubwirwa umuganga vuba.
MenopauseHormones.85: Bitewe n'imiterere, umuhanga ashobora kugusaba ubundi buryo butandukanye:
MenopauseHormones.87: Imyitozo ngororamubiri, imirire, no kugenzura umunaniro w'ubwenge n'ibitotsi.
MenopauseHormones.89: Uburyo bumwe bushobora kwibanda ku bimenyetso byihariye, bitewe n'imiterere.
MenopauseHormones.91: Iganirwaho na muganga igihe ikwiranye n'imiterere yawe n'ibyo ukeneye.
MenopauseHormones.92: Ibi byemezo bikomeza kuba ibya buri wese: bishingira ku mateka yawe, ibimenyetso byawe, ingaruka, n'ibyo wishimira.
MenopauseHormones.93: Impinduka z'imisemburo ni igice cy'ingenzi cyo kwimukira muri menopause.
MenopauseHormones.94: Urugero rw'imisemburo rushobora guhindagurika cyane mu gihe cya perimenopause, nta kugabanuka kugororotse neza.
MenopauseHormones.95: Ibimenyetso bitandukana cyane hagati y'umuntu n'undi, no kuva ku kwezi ujya ku kundi.
MenopauseHormones.96: Gukurikirana ibimenyetso byawe bishobora kugufasha kubona neza imiterere yawe bwite.
MenopauseHormones.97: Umuhanga mu buzima ashobora kugufasha niba ibimenyetso bigoye kubigenzura.
MenopauseHormones.98: Ibikubiyemo by'amakuru. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye. Niba ufite impungenge, shaka inama z'umuganga.
MenopauseHormones.99: Imisemburo mu gihe cya menopause — AWA

MenopauseTransition.1: Gusobanukirwa igihe cyo kwimukira muri menopause
MenopauseTransition.6: Ibihinduka buhoro buhoro, imyaka mbere y'uko imihango ihagarara, n'uko wakwegera iki cyiciro ufite ubusobanuro burushijeho.
MenopauseTransition.13: Imyumvire itari yo isanzwe kuri menopause
MenopauseTransition.18: Perimenopause ni igihe cyo kwimuka kw'imisemburo kibanziriza menopause: gishobora gutangira imyaka myinshi mbere, muri rusange guhera ku myaka mirongo ine, aho urugero rwa estrogen ruhindagurika mu buryo budahoraho.
MenopauseTransition.19: Menopause, ku rundi ruhande, ni akanya kihariye: yemezwa nyuma y'amezi 12 akurikiranye nta mihango, nta yindi mpamvu. Mu Bufaransa, iba ahagana ku myaka 51 ugereranyije, nubwo iyo myaka ihinduka mu buryo karemano hagati y'umugore n'undi.
MenopauseTransition.21: Buri mugore anyura muri iki gihe cyo kwimuka mu buryo bwe, haba mu gihe imara no mu bukana bw'ibimenyetso. Kubiganiraho ku mugaragaro bigufasha kubyitegura neza.
MenopauseTransition.23: Kimwe mu bimenyetso bya mbere bya perimenopause akenshi ni impinduka mu muvuduko w'uruhererekane: uruhererekane rushobora kuba rugufi, rurerure, rutandukanye cyane, cyangwa rugira amaraso atandukanye kuva ku kwezi ujya ku kundi.
MenopauseTransition.25: Kuva amaraso menshi cyane, kuva amaraso yegeranye cyane, cyangwa kuva amaraso nyuma y'umwaka nta mihango bisaba inama z'abaganga, kuko ibi bitafatwa nk'ibimenyetso bisanzwe by'iki gihe cyo kwimuka.
MenopauseTransition.27: Kumanuka no guhindagurika kwa estrogen na progesterone bishobora guhungabanya ibitotsi (gusinzira, gukanguka nijoro) kandi bishobora guherekezwa no kurakara, guhangayika, cyangwa guhindagurika kudasanzwe kw'imyumvire.
MenopauseTransition.28: Izi mpinduka zifite ubusobanuro nyabwo bw'ibinyabuzima: ntizigaragaza kubura ubushake cyangwa ikibazo cyo mu mutwe cyihariye.
MenopauseTransition.30: Kugabanuka kwa estrogen bishobora gutera kuma kw'igitsina, rimwe na rimwe bigatera kutamererwa neza cyangwa ububabare mu gihe cyo gutera akabariro. Ubushake na bwo bushobora guhinduka, bukiyongera cyangwa bukagabanuka, bitewe n'umugore.
MenopauseTransition.32: Hari ibisubizo byoroshye (amavuta yorohereza, amavuta atuma igitsina gitoha, imiti yo hanze): kuganira n'umuhanga mu buzima bishobora kugufasha kubona igisubizo gikwiye, nta bwoba.
MenopauseTransition.34: Metabolism ishobora kugabanya umuvuduko gato muri iki gihe, kandi ikwirakwira ry'ibinure rikunze kwerekeza ku nda. Izi mpinduka ni zisanzwe kandi ntizishingira ku bushake gusa.
MenopauseTransition.35: 6. Imyumvire itari yo isanzwe kuri menopause
MenopauseTransition.36: Menopause "ibaho icyarimwe" — mu by'ukuri, ibanzirizwa n'imyaka myinshi yo kwimuka (perimenopause)
MenopauseTransition.37: Ibimenyetso byose ni bikomeye kuri bose — ubukana bwabyo butandukana cyane hagati y'abagore
MenopauseTransition.38: Nta cyo wakora — hari ibisubizo byinshi, bikoresha imisemburo cyangwa bitayikoresha, byo koroshya ibimenyetso bibangamira
MenopauseTransition.39: Ubuzima bw'abashakanye burarangira — burahinduka, ariko bukomeza gushoboka kandi bukanezeza hamwe n'impinduka zikwiye
MenopauseTransition.41: Impinduka nyinshi zivugwa hano ni ibigaragaza bisanzwe by'iki gihe cyo kwimuka. Icyakora, ibimenyetso bimwe bisaba ubuvuzi bwihuse.
MenopauseTransition.43: Kuva amaraso nyuma ya menopause yemejwe, ububabare budasanzwe bwo mu nda yo hasi, ibimenyetso bibangamira cyane ubuzima bwa buri munsi, cyangwa gushidikanya kwose guhoraho.
MenopauseTransition.45: Imirire irimo calcium na fibre nyinshi
MenopauseTransition.48: Ibihe bya buri munsi byo kuruhuka
MenopauseTransition.51: Perimenopause na menopause ni ibyiciro karemano, si indwara. Hari ibisubizo byinshi bigufasha kunyura muri iki gihe cyo kwimuka neza: umuhanga mu buzima akomeza kuba isoko nziza yo kubihuza n'imiterere yawe.
MenopauseTransition.52: Gusobanukirwa igihe cyo kwimukira muri menopause — AWA

MenopauseTreatments.6: Ubuvuzi busimbura imisemburo n'ubundi buryo butayikoresha, bigufasha kwitegura ikiganiro na muganga wawe.
MenopauseTreatments.13: Ubuvuzi busimbura imisemburo muri menopause (HRT) busimbura igabanuka rya estrogen kandi bushobora koroshya ibimenyetso bibangamira cyane, nk'umushyiko, ibibazo by'ibitotsi, cyangwa kuma kw'igitsina.
MenopauseTreatments.14: HRT ishobora kandi gufasha kurinda ubwinshi bw'amagufwa. Icyakora, ntikwiye buri miterere: amateka yawe bwite y'indwara zimwe (indwara z'umutima n'imitsi, kanseri zimwe zishingira ku misemburo) ashobora kugabanya ikoreshwa ryayo.
MenopauseTreatments.16: Uburinganire hagati y'inyungu n'ingaruka za HRT bushingira ku myaka yawe, igihe itangirwa ugereranyije na menopause, n'amateka yawe bwite y'ubuvuzi: hakenewe isuzuma ry'ubuvuzi rihuje n'umuntu ku giti cye mbere yo gufata icyemezo cyose.
MenopauseTreatments.17: Iyo HRT idashakwa cyangwa idakwiye, hari ubundi buryo bwo gufasha koroshya ibimenyetso:
MenopauseTreatments.18: Ubuvuzi bwo guhindura imitekerereze n'imyitwarire (mu kugenzura umunaniro w'ubwenge n'ibitotsi)
MenopauseTreatments.19: Imiti y'ibimera, ikurikiranywe n'umuhanga mu buzima
MenopauseTreatments.21: Amavuta yorohereza n'amavuta atuma igitsina gitoha ku kuma kw'ibice by'ibanga
MenopauseTreatments.23: N'imiti y'ibimera ikwiye inama z'umuhanga: “karemano” ntivuze “idafite ingaruka zishoboka” zo kuvanga n'indi miti.
MenopauseTreatments.24: Gutegura ingingo zimwe mbere yo kubonana bigufasha gukoresha neza ikiganiro:
MenopauseTreatments.25: Ibimenyetso bya buri munsi bikubangamira cyane
MenopauseTreatments.26: Amateka yawe bwite n'ay'umuryango mu buvuzi
MenopauseTreatments.27: Ibyo wishimira (imisemburo cyangwa idakoreshwa, igihe utekereza)
MenopauseTreatments.28: Ibibazo byawe n'impungenge zawe — ntuzuyaze kubibaza
MenopauseTreatments.30: Haba hakoreshwa imisemburo cyangwa idakoreshwa, nta muti ukwiye bose: ibikubereye bishingira ku miterere yawe bwite, ipimwa hamwe n'umuhanga mu buzima.

MenstruationPurity.6: Gusobanukirwa isano iri hagati y'uruhererekane n'imimerere y'isuku yo kubaha, kugira ngo wegere iki gihe ufite ubusobanuro burushijeho.
MenstruationPurity.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni iby'inyigisho gusa. Ibibazo by'idini bigomba kwemezwa n'abahanga babifitiye ubushobozi. AWA ntitanga fatwa cyangwa imyanzuro y'idini yihariye.
MenstruationPurity.10: Gusobanukirwa icyo isuku yo kubaha ivuze
MenstruationPurity.11: Imihango no gusonerwa ibikorwa byo kuramya
MenstruationPurity.12: Nyuma y'imihango: kumenya kugaruka mu isuku
MenstruationPurity.16: Mu migenzo y'Isilamu, isuku yo kubaha (tahara) ivuga imimerere isabwa kugira ngo ukore ibikorwa bimwe byo kuramya, nk'isengesho. Ntivuga isuku mu buryo busanzwe, ahubwo ni imimerere yihariye yemewe na fiqh, ihinduka bitewe n'ibyiciro by'uruhererekane rw'umugore.
MenstruationPurity.17: Mu gihe cy'imihango, umugore asonerwa ibikorwa bimwe byo kuramya, cyane cyane isengesho na sawm ya Ramadan, bishobora kwishyurwa nyuma. Uku gusonerwa kumenyekana nk'ubworoherezwe, si igihano.
MenstruationPurity.20: Kumva cyangwa gusoma ibikubiyemo by'inyigisho n'iby'umwuka
MenstruationPurity.24: Utuntu tumwe (nko gusoma Quran mu buryo butaziguye cyangwa kwinjira mu musigiti) dushobora gutandukana bitewe n'ishuri ry'amategeko y'idini; ni byiza kwiyambaza igitekerezo usanzwe ukurikiza cyangwa umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi kuri ibyo bihe byihariye.
MenstruationPurity.25: Impera y'imihango igaragaza kugaruka buhoro buhoro ku mimerere y'isuku yo kubaha. Mu buryo bw'umubiri, ibi bihura no guhagarara kw'amaraso, ikimenyetso amashuri anyuranye y'abahanga ashobora gusobanura n'utuntu duto dutandukanye.
MenstruationPurity.27: Gusobanukirwa ibyiciro by'uruhererekane bigufasha kumenya neza igihe imihango irangira koko.
MenstruationPurity.28: Iyo iki kimenyetso kimaze kugaragara, ghusl (koga gukomeye) iha ububasha bwo kugaruka mu isuku yo kubaha no gusubukura ibikorwa byo kuramya byari byahagaritswe.
MenstruationPurity.29: Ghusl ni koga gukomeye kw'umuhango, gukubiyemo koza umubiri wose ufite nia yo kwisukura. Ihagarika gusonerwa kandi ituma isengesho risubukurwa nk'ibisanzwe, bitari ngombwa kwishyura amasengesho yasibwe mu gihe cy'imihango.
MenstruationPurity.31: Uburyo nyabwo ghusl ikorwamo bushobora gutandukana gato bitewe n'ishuri ry'amategeko y'idini rikurikizwa.
MenstruationPurity.33: Niba utazi intambwe nyazo zikurikizwa mu ishuri ryawe, umuntu wizeye cyangwa umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi azabigusobanurira neza.
MenstruationPurity.34: Birasanzwe kugira gushidikanya ku gihe imihango yarangiye koko, cyane cyane iyo amaraso agabanuka buhoro buhoro aho guhagarara gitunguranye.
MenstruationPurity.36: Reba ko nta maraso ahari rwose, si ukugabanuka gusa
MenstruationPurity.37: Reka igihe gihagije gihite mbere yo kwemeza ko imihango yarangiye
MenstruationPurity.38: Shingira ku kwitegereza kugaragara aho gushingira ku mpuha gusa
MenstruationPurity.39: Ita ku muvuduko wawe usanzwe, ushobora gutandukana kuva ku ruhererekane ujya ku rundi
MenstruationPurity.41: Mu gihe cyo kuva amaraso kumaze igihe kirekire cyangwa kudahoraho, cyangwa gushidikanya guhoraho, ibyo bihe bikwiye kuganirwaho n'umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi, ushobora kukuyobora ukurikije imiterere yawe bwite. Ibi bikubiyemo bikomeza kuba iby'amakuru kandi ntibisimbura ubuyobozi bw'idini bwihariye.
MenstruationPurity.43: Ibi bimenyetso ni ibyibutsa rusange by'inyigisho. Buri miterere ishobora kugira umwihariko wayo: mu gihe cyo gushidikanya, kuganira n'umuhanga ubifitiye ubushobozi bikomeza kuba isoko nziza y'igisubizo gikwiranye n'imiterere yawe.
MenstruationPurity.44: Imimerere y'isuku yo kubaha: ibanze — AWA

MiscarriageFertility.0: NYUMA YO GUTWITA INDA ISENYUKA • UBUREREKE
MiscarriageFertility.1: Uburereke no kongera kugerageza nyuma yo gutakaza inda
MiscarriageFertility.6: Igihe n'uburyo bwo gutekereza ku kongera kugerageza, ku muvuduko wawe kandi ufite icyizere cyuzuye.
MiscarriageFertility.13: Uburereke bukunze kugaruka kuva ku ruhererekane rukurikira gutakaza inda hakiri kare. Ovulation ishobora no kubaho mbere y'uko imihango yawe igaragara.
MiscarriageFertility.15: Bitewe n'icyiciro inda yatakariyemo, igihe cyo gukira mu buryo bw'umubiri gishobora gutandukana gato hagati y'imiterere imwe n'indi.
MiscarriageFertility.16: Abahanga benshi bemeza ko nta mpamvu yo gutegereza ibyiciro by'uruhererekane byinshi mbere yo kongera kugerageza, keretse muganga wawe cyangwa umubyaza akugiriye inama zinyuranye.
MiscarriageFertility.18: Uburereke akenshi bugaruka vuba, kuva ku ruhererekane rukurikira.
MiscarriageFertility.20: Itsinda ry'abaganga rishobora kugusaba igihe kirekire gato cyo gukira.
MiscarriageFertility.21: Kumva witeguye, mu buryo bw'umubiri n'amarangamutima, bikomeza kuba ikiyobora cy'ingenzi — kurusha igihe icyo ari cyo cyose cya gihanga.
MiscarriageFertility.23: Kumva witeguye imbere muri wowe bifite akamaro nk'ak'gukira mu buryo bw'umubiri.
MiscarriageFertility.25: Uruhererekane ruhoraho no kumva umeze neza ni ibimenyetso byiza.
MiscarriageFertility.27: Kubiganiraho n'uwo mubana bishobora kugufasha gukomeza ku muvuduko umwe.
MiscarriageFertility.28: Mbere yo kongera kugerageza, gahunda yo kubonana na muganga ishobora kugufasha gukomeza ufite amahoro menshi:
MiscarriageFertility.32: Bitewe n'imiterere, hashobora gutangwa ibindi bizamini.
MiscarriageFertility.34: Ukurikiranwa ashobora gukomeza kugushyigikira utuje mu kongera kugerageza.
MiscarriageFertility.36: Gutakaza inda rimwe gusa muri rusange ntibigaragaza ikibazo cy'uburereke. Itsinda ry'abaganga bawe ni ryo rishobora gusubiza neza ibibazo byawe bwite.
MiscarriageFertility.37: Uburereke bukunze kugaruka kuva ku ruhererekane rukurikira gutakaza inda hakiri kare.
MiscarriageFertility.38: Abahanga benshi bemeza ko nta mpamvu yo gutegereza ibyiciro by'uruhererekane byinshi, keretse hatanzwe izindi nama.
MiscarriageFertility.39: Kumva witeguye, mu buryo bw'umubiri n'amarangamutima, bikomeza kuba ikiyobora cy'ingenzi.
MiscarriageFertility.40: Ukurikiranwa n'abaganga ashobora kugushyigikira no kugutuza mbere yo kongera kugerageza.
MiscarriageFertility.41: Ibikubiyemo by'amakuru. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama z'ubuvuzi zihariye. Muganga wawe cyangwa umubyaza akomeza kuba ishingiro ry'imiterere yawe.
MiscarriageFertility.42: Uburereke no kongera kugerageza nyuma yo gutakaza inda — AWA

MiscarriageGrief.0: NYUMA YO GUTWITA INDA ISENYUKA • INKUNGA Y'AMARANGAMUTIMA
MiscarriageGrief.6: Nta buryo bwiza bwo kunyuramo. Buri wese anyura muri byo mu buryo bwe, ku muvuduko we.
MiscarriageGrief.14: Agahinda, uburakari, cyangwa kumva ubusa ni ibisubizo bisanzwe kuri uku gutakaza, uko icyiciro cy'inda cyaba kimeze kose. Ibyo wumva bikwiye kwemerwa.
MiscarriageGrief.16: Nta buryo bwiza cyangwa bubi bwo kunyuramo. Buri marangamutima wumva ni ukuri.
MiscarriageGrief.17: Ushobora kumva kimwe cyangwa byinshi muri ibi, rimwe na rimwe byose icyarimwe:
MiscarriageGrief.19: Intimba ishobora kuza ikagenda, rimwe na rimwe bitunguranye.
MiscarriageGrief.21: Kuri wowe ubwawe, ku miterere, cyangwa kumva hari akarengane — kandi ibyo nta cyo guhangayikira.
MiscarriageGrief.23: Kumva ubusa cyangwa urujijo ku byo byabaye.
MiscarriageGrief.24: Kwiha igihe, nta gahato cyangwa ugereranya, ni igice cy'ingenzi cyo gukira.
MiscarriageGrief.26: Nta gahato cyangwa itariki ntarengwa yo “koroherwa.”
MiscarriageGrief.28: Buri gahinda ni umwihariko; nta buryo bwiza bwo kunyuramo.
MiscarriageGrief.30: Kwandika cyangwa kuvuga ku byo wumva bishobora gufasha koroshya uburemere bw'amarangamutima yawe.
MiscarriageGrief.31: Kuganira n'umuntu ukwegereye, itsinda ry'inkunga, cyangwa umuhanga bishobora gufasha koroshya uyu mutwaro. Dore uko abakwegereye bashobora gufasha:
MiscarriageGrief.33: Umutege amatwi nta guca urubanza, nubwo utabona amagambo ahamye
MiscarriageGrief.34: Irinde gusuzugura ibyabaye (“si ikintu gikomeye,” “ushobora kongera kugerageza”)
MiscarriageGrief.35: Tanga ko uri hafi aho gutanga ibisubizo
MiscarriageGrief.36: Komeza kubaza uko ameze mu byumweru bikurikira
MiscarriageGrief.37: Ibimenyetso bimwe bishobora kugaragaza ko ubufasha bw'umuhanga bwagufasha:
MiscarriageGrief.39: Agahinda kamara igihe kirekire kakiyongera aho koroha
MiscarriageGrief.42: Ibitekerezo bitera ubwoba cyangwa agahinda gakabije biragaragara
MiscarriageGrief.44: Umubyaza, muganga, umuhanga mu mitekerereze, cyangwa itsinda ry'inkunga bashobora kukumva no kugushyigikira, nta guca urubanza.
MiscarriageGrief.46: Gusaba ubufasha si ikimenyetso cy'intege nke — ni uburyo bwo kwita ku buzima bwawe muri iki gihe.
MiscarriageGrief.47: Nta buryo bwiza cyangwa bubi bwo kunyura muri ibi bibazo.
MiscarriageGrief.48: Agahinda, uburakari, cyangwa kumva ubusa ni ibisubizo bisanzwe.
MiscarriageGrief.49: Kwiha igihe, nta gahato cyangwa ugereranya, ni igice cyo gukira.
MiscarriageGrief.50: Kuganira n'umuntu ukwegereye, itsinda ry'inkunga, cyangwa umuhanga bishobora gufasha koroshya uyu mutwaro.
MiscarriageGrief.51: Ibikubiyemo by'amakuru. Iyi nkuru ntisimbura inama z'umuhanga. Niba unyura mu gihe kigoye, ntuzuyaze kuganira n'umuhanga mu buzima.
MiscarriageGrief.52: Kunyura mu gahinda mu marangamutima — AWA
